title: Physical Layer Primer
scenario: Welcome to Physical Layer Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Unshielded Twisted Pair (UTP): Most common LAN cabling. Cat5e (1 Gbps/100m), Cat6 (1 Gbps/100m or 10 Gbps/55m), Cat6A (10 Gbps/100m), Cat8 (40 Gbps/30m). TIA-568: max 90m horizontal + 10m patch = 100m total. Spanning Tree Protocol (STP): IEEE 802.1D. Prevents Layer 2 loops by blocking redundant paths. States: Blocking → Listening → Learning → Forwarding (30-50 sec). Root bridge = lowest Bridge ID. Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU): Largest Layer 3 packet size a link can carry. Ethernet default = 1500 bytes. Jumbo frames = 9000 bytes. MTU mismatch causes fragmentation or black-holing with PMTUD.
